name: Z-Algorithm
description: Builds the Z-array for a string where Z[i] is the length of the longest substring starting from position i that matches a prefix of the string.
aim: Compute Z-array in O(n) using a window [L,R] of the longest Z-box found so far, reusing previous computations.
howItWorks: Z[0] = n (the whole string matches prefix of itself)
Maintain Z-box [L,R]: longest matching window found
For each i: if inside Z-box, use previous Z values
Extend match beyond R, update Z-box

realWorld: Finding all occurrences of a pattern
alternatives: Suffix array — more powerful but harder to implement
